inputs.CURRENT_INSTRUCTION: Complete the inherited ansibleops Terraform provider under /app/provider so the ten resources already defined in /app/provider/docs/provider-contract.md, /app/provider/docs/resource-reference.md and /app/provider/docs/lifecycle.md behave like normal managed Terraform resources.
